turns.prompt: Use the attached courtyard schematic as a relationship reference for an original compact reading pavilion. It is an authored diagram, not a construction drawing. Build two procedural facade approaches A and B in Blender, using the same outer envelope, entrance position, camera, and lighting so their rules can be compared. The entrance should read as part of the structural bay rhythm and lead into an open courtyard, not look like a detached decorated door. Keep a clear threshold between outside and reading space. Expose meaningful controls for bay proportions, upper-opening variation, and threshold depth in source.py. Make an actual parameter-probe scene/render that changes only threshold depth while preserving the envelope and camera. Reopen the saved native scene and render it; label architectural feasibility as untested rather than claiming a construction-ready building. Deliver scene.blend, source.py, a.png, b.png, side.png, parameter-probe.png, evidence.json, notes.md. Keep these filenames on every turn. PNG previews must use the declared dimensions; include actual rendered results, not an empty placeholder. All four PNGs are actual 640x480 Blender renders. Save both labeled alternatives in scene.blend; expose meaningful parameters in source.py and document a real parameter change and independent saved-scene reopen in evidence.json. Native scene editability is required; a flat drawing is insufficient.

Choose A for the entrance-to-bay relationship, not its perfectly repeated windows. Keep B unchanged. Change only A's upper-opening variation so adjacent bays have a restrained rhythm without losing plausible vertical support. Preserve the envelope, entrance, threshold depth, camera, and lighting. Show the same comparison and a side view of A. Deliver scene.blend, source.py, a.png, b.png, side.png, parameter-probe.png, evidence.json, notes.md. Keep these filenames on every turn. PNG previews must use the declared dimensions; include actual rendered results, not an empty placeholder. All four PNGs are actual 640x480 Blender renders. Save both labeled alternatives in scene.blend; expose meaningful parameters in source.py and document a real parameter change and independent saved-scene reopen in evidence.json. Native scene editability is required; a flat drawing is insufficient.

Keep that upper rhythm. Refine only the transition from the entrance shade into the courtyard so it reads as one connected threshold rather than a floating awning. Preserve support alignment, envelope, camera, and all upper openings. Repeat a native reopen and the same threshold-depth parameter probe, stating what was actually regenerated versus only proposed. Deliver scene.blend, source.py, a.png, b.png, side.png, parameter-probe.png, evidence.json, notes.md. Keep these filenames on every turn. PNG previews must use the declared dimensions; include actual rendered results, not an empty placeholder. All four PNGs are actual 640x480 Blender renders. Save both labeled alternatives in scene.blend; expose meaningful parameters in source.py and document a real parameter change and independent saved-scene reopen in evidence.json. Native scene editability is required; a flat drawing is insufficient.
